items.fact: The campaign is split into five chapters and contains 91 story missions, according to PC Gamer's mission list (other outlets count 93).
Dexerto's mission list also counts 91 missions across five chapters. The chapter titles are Just Like Paradise, Paradise Lost, Tits Ass Drug Money, Vice City Baby, and Top of the World, Ma.
Outlets disagree on the mission total. Insider Gaming counts 93 main story missions in five chapters, and Push Square also gives 93.
Completed story missions cannot be replayed in GTA 6.
The game has two playable protagonists, Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Early on, Chapter 1 has you control only Jason.
The game is set in the state of Leonida. Regions include Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga National Park.
There are 18 collectible card sets, but only 15 need to be completed for 100% completion.
There are 33 underwater discovery locations. You dig up artefacts with a metal detector and sell them to Kenton.

The 100% checklist includes 100 WAiNK locations scanned, 100 cocaine flamingos destroyed, 30 magazines/books/comics, and 15 meditation spots. It also requires 100 animals discovered, out of more than 160.
There are 23 WAiNK sculptures to find, and you get a notification when one is nearby.
From Chapter 2, stealing cars for the mechanic Moses is a low-risk way to earn money. Randy, who appears from Chapter 3, pays more for flashier cars.
Randy keeps a wish list of 18 high-end sports cars, and delivering one can pay $30,000 or more. Bank vaults, unlocked near the end of Chapter 4, can pay up to $200,000.
There are 40 unique race locations. Races cost an entry fee and a vehicle rental fee, and winning gives a net profit.
Rival gang hideouts appear as map icons showing the gang, the security level and the possible score. They pay out almost immediately when you hand the goods to a dealer.
The demolition derby at Ambrosia Raceway pays over $3,000 on the oval track and double that on the figure-eight, and it can be repeated.
Check the map for back doors before robbing a place. The snap gun lets you enter without setting off the alarm. Medium- and high-security targets are much easier with a partner.
Don't rob banks or loan stores until Chapter 3, because their cash carries exploding dye packs. You need a dye pack jammer to avoid them.
The RydeMe app can fast-travel you for $100. Buses and trains are a cheaper option, but they run on schedules.

Ultimate Edition bonus vehicles include the Dinka Endura military motorcycle and Crest Kayak in Chapter 1, the Dominator Buggy in Chapter 2, and the Shitzu Squalo speedboat in Chapter 4. The '95 Grotti Cheetah arrives in Chapter 5.
The Scooter Bros app lets you spawn and repair your owned vehicles for a fee. Premium gives three free uses per in-game day.
Rockstar told Kotaku that no 60 fps or 40 fps mode is coming to any launch console, including the PS5 Pro.
PS5 players must install system software update 26.07-14.23.00 before they can play GTA 6.
On launch day some PS5 players hit PlayStation Network errors, including trouble redeeming codes and upgrading a GTA 6 edition. Some of those problems cleared after repeated attempts.
